status_vocabulary.implemented_on_feature_branch: Present only on ace-ct-inspired-evaluator and this presentation branch; not merged to main.

status_vocabulary.experimental: Gated and unvalidated; not a production or clinical claim.

current_plugins.name: DefaultLLMPatientModel
current_plugins.behavior: Builds a case- and SPIKES-stage-aware prompt and delegates patient response generation to the configured OpenAI or Gemini adapter.
current_plugins.produces: One simulated patient response for a clinician turn.
current_plugins.limitation: It is a general case-script patient; OpenAI and Gemini are provider adapters within the same plugin, not separate patient-model plugins.

current_plugins.name: ApexBaselineEvaluator
current_plugins.behavior: Rule-only wrapper around non-LLM APEX scoring.
current_plugins.produces: APEX feedback and scores derived from SPIKES/AFCE-oriented rule processing.
current_plugins.limitation: Rule patterns can miss context and indirect language.

current_plugins.name: ApexHybridEvaluator
current_plugins.behavior: Combines the rule-based core with an optional LLM review/merge path.
current_plugins.produces: Persistable APEX feedback and canonical score fields.
current_plugins.limitation: Real hybrid review requires a configured OpenAI provider/model and can incur paid calls.

current_plugins.name: ApexHybridV2Evaluator
current_plugins.behavior: Combines the rule core with three focused LLM reviews and a documented 70/30 merge.
current_plugins.produces: APEX feedback with focused reviewer contributions and canonical score fields.
current_plugins.limitation: Real review remains OpenAI-only in the comparison definition and needs frozen prompt/model provenance for study use.

current_plugins.name: ACECTInspiredRubricEvaluator
current_plugins.behavior: Projects an interleaved transcript into a strict provider-neutral, versioned 11-dimension experimental rubric and preserves typed framework results.
current_plugins.produces: Evidence-linked dimension/domain results plus explicitly provisional APEX compatibility fields.
current_plugins.limitation: Pending expert review; gated; transcript-only; not official ACE-CT automation; not a reproduction of private data, models, weights, results, examples, or unpublished anchors.
current_plugins.source_label: authorized confidential manuscript; public citation pending expert confirmation

current_plugins.name: ApexMetrics
current_plugins.behavior: Computes AFCE-style opportunity/response counts and SPIKES coverage from stored turns.
current_plugins.limitation: It reuses current rule/span helpers and does not establish evaluator validity.

candidate_plugins.name: Minimal adaptive-patient state

literature_inspiration.citation: Lee et al. 2025, Adaptive-VP

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Let a synthetic patient's affect, trust, disclosure, or resistance respond to clinician behavior across turns.
candidate_plugins.dependency: A small explicit state model, transition rules, stable fixtures, and safety review.
candidate_plugins.risk: State behavior could distract from the evaluator demo or create difficult-to-reproduce conversations.

candidate_plugins.name: Service-flow-aware patient

literature_inspiration.citation: Bao et al. 2025, SFMSS

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Represent scenario phases and expected care-flow transitions when generating dialogue.
candidate_plugins.dependency: Authorized service-flow schemas, case authoring support, and coverage validation.
candidate_plugins.risk: Flow fidelity may be mistaken for clinical correctness without domain review.

candidate_plugins.name: Emotion-aware patient

literature_inspiration.citation: Feng et al. 2024, Infusing Emotions into Task-oriented Dialogue Systems

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Make emotion state explicit enough to test whether clinician responses change subsequent patient behavior.
candidate_plugins.dependency: Emotion-state definitions, transition policy, and expert-reviewed scenarios.
candidate_plugins.risk: Stereotyped or over-dramatic affect can reduce realism and fairness.

candidate_plugins.name: Mental-health-specific patient

literature_inspiration.citation: Wang et al. 2024, PATIENT-psi
Atapattu et al. 2025, Mental Health Conversational Agents in Training

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Support specialized training scenarios with domain-appropriate patient behavior and evaluation boundaries.
candidate_plugins.dependency: Clinical governance, risk controls, expert-authored cases, and targeted validation.
candidate_plugins.risk: High safety, representation, and misuse risk; unsuitable as a rushed system-demo addition.

candidate_plugins.name: Speech-to-speech patient

literature_inspiration.citation: Emerson et al. 2026, Speech-to-Speech Virtual Standardized Patients

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Enable a more natural spoken encounter and eventually expose timing/prosody signals unavailable in text.
candidate_plugins.dependency: Low-latency audio pipeline, consent/privacy controls, multimodal storage policy, and audio evaluation.
candidate_plugins.risk: Latency, accessibility, privacy, cost, and validation complexity are substantial.

candidate_plugins.name: Empathy-intent evaluator

literature_inspiration.citation: Jiang et al. 2023, Empathy Intent Drives Empathy Detection

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Add an intent-oriented lens beside AFCE opportunities and observable response forms.
candidate_plugins.dependency: A public operationalization, labeled review examples, and construct-overlap analysis.
candidate_plugins.risk: Intent should not be inferred as fact from wording alone.

candidate_plugins.name: Non-emotion-centric empathy evaluator

literature_inspiration.citation: Huangfu et al. 2025, Non-Emotion-Centric Empathetic Dialogue Generation
Lahnala et al. 2022, A Critical Reflection and Forward Perspective on Empathy and NLP

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Broaden analysis beyond emotion words toward supportive, perspective-sensitive communication behavior.
candidate_plugins.dependency: A clearly bounded construct, labels, and comparison against AFCE to avoid double-counting.
candidate_plugins.risk: Conceptual overlap can produce persuasive but uninterpretable scores.

candidate_plugins.name: Patient-simulation-quality evaluator

literature_inspiration.citation: Shi et al. 2024, Medical Dialogue System survey
Bao et al. 2025, SFMSS

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Evaluate whether the virtual patient stays consistent with the synthetic case, role, and dialogue flow.
candidate_plugins.dependency: Case-grounded criteria and adversarial fixtures independent of learner scoring.
candidate_plugins.risk: A model judge may reward stylistic plausibility rather than case fidelity.

candidate_plugins.name: Supervised embedding/regression ACE-CT evaluator

literature_inspiration.citation: Public ACE-CT article
authorized confidential manuscript; public citation pending expert confirmation

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Test a supervised research baseline only if authorized labels and an approved construct become available.
candidate_plugins.dependency: Authorized labeled data, governance, train/test protocol, expert raters, and external validation.
candidate_plugins.risk: Data scarcity, leakage, and unauthorized reproduction claims.

candidate_plugins.name: Transformer ACE-CT evaluator

literature_inspiration.citation: Public ACE-CT article
authorized confidential manuscript; public citation pending expert confirmation

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Explore a task-specific model only after the rubric, data rights, labels, and validation design are settled.
candidate_plugins.dependency: Substantial authorized data, compute, governance, reproducible baselines, and independent validation.
candidate_plugins.risk: Overfitting, opaque failure modes, and conflation with the unpublished system.

candidate_plugins.name: Transcript dynamics

literature_inspiration.citation: Wang et al. 2025, Computational Linguistic Approach to Empathy and its Language Communication Pattern

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Measure turn balance, question cadence, response adjacency, and deterministic sequence features.
candidate_plugins.dependency: Metric definitions, fixtures, and careful interpretation of transcript-only proxies.
candidate_plugins.risk: Conversation quantity can be mistaken for communication quality.

candidate_plugins.name: Jargon and readability

literature_inspiration.citation: ACE-CT-inspired provisional direction; authorized confidential manuscript; public citation pending expert confirmation

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Expose deterministic terminology and readability signals alongside evaluator interpretation.
candidate_plugins.dependency: A transparent term list/readability policy and audience-context caveats.
candidate_plugins.risk: Readability formulas do not establish patient understanding.

candidate_plugins.name: Question and understanding checks

literature_inspiration.citation: Lahnala et al. 2024, Appraisal Framework for Clinical Empathy
ACE-CT-inspired provisional direction; authorized confidential manuscript; public citation pending expert confirmation

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Count invitations, checks, and observable teach-back sequences with turn-linked evidence.
candidate_plugins.dependency: Rule definitions and manual review of false positives.
candidate_plugins.risk: A question mark is not necessarily an understanding check.

candidate_plugins.name: Evidence grounding

literature_inspiration.citation: Shi et al. 2024, Medical Dialogue System: A Survey of Categories, Methods, Evaluation and Challenges

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Verify that each structured finding points to a valid turn and quantify unsupported or duplicated references.
candidate_plugins.dependency: A stable evidence schema across evaluators.
candidate_plugins.risk: Valid coordinates do not prove that the interpretation is correct.

candidate_plugins.name: Evaluator stability

literature_inspiration.citation: Shi et al. 2024, Medical Dialogue System: A Survey of Categories, Methods, Evaluation and Challenges

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Measure repeated-run variance under frozen prompt, provider, model, and transcript conditions.
candidate_plugins.dependency: Authorized repeated calls, cost budget, and frozen provenance.

candidate_plugins.name: Patient consistency

literature_inspiration.citation: Lee et al. 2025, Adaptive-VP
Wang et al. 2024, PATIENT-psi

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Track contradictions against the synthetic case and explicit patient state.
candidate_plugins.dependency: Structured case facts and an auditable consistency policy.
candidate_plugins.risk: Flexible human-like dialogue may be misclassified as inconsistency.

candidate_plugins.name: Service-flow coverage

literature_inspiration.citation: Bao et al. 2025, SFMSS

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Measure whether expected synthetic scenario phases were visited without treating order alone as quality.
candidate_plugins.risk: Rigid flow metrics may punish appropriate conversational adaptation.

candidate_plugins.name: Audio interaction metrics

literature_inspiration.citation: Emerson et al. 2026, Speech-to-Speech Virtual Standardized Patients

candidate_plugins.value_to_apex: Eventually measure latency, overlap, pause distribution, and other observable spoken-interaction signals.
candidate_plugins.dependency: Consent, audio capture, signal-processing definitions, accessibility, and validation.
candidate_plugins.risk: Sensitive raw audio and uncertain links between proxies and communication quality.
